s.t: Little Red Riding Hood lived in a small village.
s.fr: Le Petit Chaperon Rouge vivait dans un petit village.

s.t: Her grandmother lived across the woods.
s.fr: Sa grand-mère vivait de l’autre côté des bois.

s.t: Grandmother gave her a red hood to wear.
s.fr: Grand-mère lui donna un capuchon rouge à porter.

s.t: She wore the red hood.
s.fr: Elle porta le capuchon rouge.

s.t: The village called her Little Red Riding Hood.
s.fr: Le village l’appela le Petit Chaperon Rouge.

s.t: One day, Grandmother was sick.
s.fr: Un jour, Grand-mère était malade.

paras.summary: Little Red Riding Hood lives in a small village near her grandmother, who once gave her a red hood that gave her the name, and one day Grandmother falls sick.

s.t: Her mother filled a basket with food.
s.fr: Sa mère remplit un panier de nourriture.

s.t: She put cake and bread into the basket.
s.fr: Elle mit du gâteau et du pain dans le panier.

s.t: "Take this to Grandmother," said her mother.
s.fr: « Portez ceci à Grand-mère, » dit sa mère.

s.t: "Do not leave the path," her mother called.
s.fr: « Ne quittez pas le chemin, » appela sa mère.

s.t: "I will be safe," said Little Red Riding Hood.
s.fr: « Je serai en sécurité, » dit le Petit Chaperon Rouge.

s.t: Then she took the basket and went into the woods.
s.fr: Puis elle prit le panier et alla dans les bois.

paras.summary: Her mother packs a basket of cake and bread, tells her to bring it to Grandmother and not to leave the path, and Little Red Riding Hood promises to be safe and sets off into the woods.

s.t: Little Red Riding Hood walked down the path.
s.fr: Le Petit Chaperon Rouge marcha sur le chemin.

s.t: A wolf came out of the woods.
s.fr: Un loup sortit des bois.

s.t: "Good day," said the wolf with a smile.
s.fr: « Bonjour, » dit le loup avec un sourire.

s.t: "Why do you have that basket?" he called.
s.fr: « Pourquoi avez-vous ce panier ? » cria-t-il.

s.t: "This food is for my sick grandmother," she said.
s.fr: « Cette nourriture est pour ma grand-mère malade, » dit-elle.

paras.summary: Little Red Riding Hood walks down the path through the woods, where a wolf comes out and greets her before asking why she carries a basket.

s.t: Grandmother lived across the woods.
s.fr: La grand-mère habitait de l’autre côté des bois.

s.t: The wolf saw the flowers.
s.fr: Le loup vit les fleurs.

s.t: "Why not pick flowers for her?" he said.
s.fr: « Pourquoi ne pas cueillir des fleurs pour elle ? » dit-il.

s.t: Little Red Riding Hood left the path to pick flowers.
s.fr: Le Petit Chaperon Rouge quitta le chemin pour cueillir des fleurs.

s.t: The wolf ran through the woods.
s.fr: Le loup courut à travers les bois.

paras.summary: She explains the food is for her sick grandmother, who lives across the woods, and the wolf points out flowers, so she leaves the path to pick some while he runs through the woods to beat her there.

s.t: The wolf reached the small house.
s.fr: Le loup atteignit la petite maison.

s.t: He knocked on the door two times.
s.fr: Il frappa à la porte deux fois.

s.t: "Who is there?" called Grandmother from her bed.
s.fr: « Qui est là ? » appela Grandmother depuis son lit.

s.t: "It is me, Little Red Riding Hood," said the wolf.
s.fr: « C’est moi, Little Red Riding Hood, » dit le loup.

s.t: "Come in, the door is open," said Grandmother.
s.fr: « Entrez, la porte est ouverte, » dit Grandmother.

paras.summary: The wolf reaches Grandmother's house first, knocks on the door, and tricks Grandmother into inviting him inside by calling out in Little Red Riding Hood's voice.

s.t: The wolf opened the door and went inside.
s.fr: Le loup ouvrit la porte et entra à l’intérieur.

s.t: The wolf swallowed Grandmother in one bite.
s.fr: Le loup avala Grandmother en une seule bouchée.

s.t: He wore Grandmother's cap.
s.fr: Il porta le bonnet de Grandmother.

s.t: He climbed into Grandmother's bed to hide.
s.fr: Il monta dans le lit de Grandmother pour se cacher.

s.t: He pulled the blanket up to hide.
s.fr: Il tira la couverture vers le haut pour se cacher.

s.t: Then the wolf waited for Little Red Riding Hood.
s.fr: Puis le loup attendit Little Red Riding Hood.

paras.summary: The wolf goes in and swallows Grandmother, then puts on her cap, climbs into her bed to hide, pulls up the blanket, and waits for Little Red Riding Hood to arrive.

s.t: Soon Little Red Riding Hood reached the quiet house.
s.fr: Bientôt Little Red Riding Hood atteignit la maison silencieuse.

s.t: She knocked gently on the wooden door two times.
s.fr: Elle frappa doucement à la porte en bois deux fois.

s.t: "Come in, the door is open," said the wolf.
s.fr: « Entrez, la porte est ouverte, » dit le loup.

s.t: Little Red Riding Hood walked slowly through the door.
s.fr: Le Petit Chaperon Rouge marcha lentement par la porte.

s.t: She saw her grandmother under the blanket.
s.fr: Elle vit sa grand-mère sous la couverture.

s.t: But her grandmother's face looked strange today.
s.fr: Mais le visage de sa grand-mère semblait étrange aujourd’hui.

paras.summary: Little Red Riding Hood reaches the quiet house, knocks, and is told to come in, but when she sees what she thinks is her grandmother under the blanket, the face looks strange today.

s.t: "Grandmother, what big eyes you have!" she said.
s.fr: « Grand-mère, quels grands yeux tu as ! » dit-elle.

s.t: "All the better to see you with," said the wolf.
s.fr: « C’est pour mieux te voir, » dit le loup.

s.t: "Grandmother, what big ears you have!" she said.
s.fr: « Grand-mère, quelles grandes oreilles tu as ! » dit-elle.

s.t: "All the better to hear you with," said the wolf.
s.fr: « C’est pour mieux t’entendre, » dit le loup.

s.t: "Grandmother, what big teeth you have!" she said.
s.fr: « Grand-mère, quelles grandes dents tu as ! » dit-elle.

s.t: "All the better to eat you with!" said the wolf.
s.fr: « C’est pour mieux te manger ! » dit le loup.

paras.summary: She asks about the big eyes, the big ears, and the big teeth she sees, and each time the wolf, still disguised as Grandmother, gives a strange reply, ending with the threat to eat her.

s.t: The wolf jumped up and swallowed Little Red Riding Hood.
s.fr: Le loup sauta et avala le Petit Chaperon Rouge.

s.t: The wolf's stomach was full, and he fell asleep.
s.fr: Le ventre du loup était plein, et il s’endormit.

s.t: A huntsman walked past the small house.
s.fr: Un chasseur passa devant la petite maison.

s.t: He heard snores from inside the house.
s.fr: Il entendit des ronflements venant de l’intérieur de la maison.

s.t: The huntsman thought Grandmother lived in that house.
s.fr: Le chasseur pensait que Grand-mère habitait dans cette maison.

paras.summary: The wolf swallows Little Red Riding Hood and falls asleep, full and heavy, and a passing huntsman hears snores from the house where he knows Grandmother lives.

s.t: He knocked, but no one came to the door.
s.fr: Il frappa, mais personne ne vint à la porte.

s.t: The huntsman opened the door and looked inside.
s.fr: Le chasseur ouvrit la porte et regarda à l’intérieur.

s.t: He saw the wolf asleep in Grandmother's bed.
s.fr: Il vit le loup endormi dans le lit de Grand-mère.

s.t: The wolf's stomach looked big.
s.fr: Le ventre du loup semblait gros.

s.t: The huntsman thought Grandmother might be inside.
s.fr: Le chasseur pensa que Grand-mère était peut-être à l’intérieur.

s.t: He took out a knife and cut open the wolf.
s.fr: Il sortit un couteau et ouvrit le ventre du loup.

s.t: Little Red Riding Hood jumped out safe!
s.fr: Le Petit Chaperon Rouge sauta dehors, saine et sauve !

paras.summary: Getting no answer at the door, the huntsman goes inside, finds the wolf asleep with a big stomach, and cuts it open with his knife, and Little Red Riding Hood jumps out safe.

s.t: Then Grandmother climbed out of the wolf too.
s.fr: Puis Grand-mère sortit aussi du ventre du loup.

s.t: She was safe.
s.fr: Elle était saine et sauve.

s.t: Little Red Riding Hood hugged her grandmother.
s.fr: Le Petit Chaperon Rouge serra sa grand-mère dans ses bras.

s.t: The huntsman found heavy stones.
s.fr: Le chasseur trouva de lourdes pierres.

s.t: Grandmother and Little Red Riding Hood filled the wolf.
s.fr: Grand-mère et Little Red Riding Hood remplirent le loup.

s.t: They put the heavy stones inside him.
s.fr: Ils mirent les lourdes pierres à l’intérieur de lui.

paras.summary: Grandmother climbs out of the wolf unharmed, and Little Red Riding Hood hugs her, while the huntsman finds heavy stones so the two of them can fill the sleeping wolf.

s.t: Soon the wolf woke up.
s.fr: Bientôt le loup se réveilla.

s.t: He wanted to run from the house.
s.fr: Il voulait courir hors de la maison.

s.t: But the stones were too heavy to carry.
s.fr: Mais les pierres étaient trop lourdes à porter.

s.t: The wolf fell down and died in the woods.
s.fr: Le loup tomba et mourut dans les bois.

s.t: Little Red Riding Hood was safe.
s.fr: Little Red Riding Hood était en sécurité.

s.t: The huntsman smiled.
s.fr: Le chasseur sourit.

paras.summary: The wolf wakes and wants to run from the house, but the stones are too heavy to carry, and he falls down dead in the woods, leaving Little Red Riding Hood safe and the huntsman smiling.

s.t: They all went inside Grandmother's small house.
s.fr: Ils entrèrent tous dans la petite maison de Grand-mère.

s.t: Little Red Riding Hood gave her the basket.
s.fr: Little Red Riding Hood lui donna le panier.

s.t: Grandmother ate the cake and the bread.
s.fr: Grand-mère mangea le gâteau et le pain.

s.t: "Thank you," said Grandmother to the huntsman.
s.fr: « Merci, » dit Grand-mère au chasseur.

s.t: "It was my pleasure," said the huntsman.
s.fr: « C’était mon plaisir, » dit le chasseur.

s.t: The huntsman left.
s.fr: Le chasseur partit.

paras.summary: They go inside, and Little Red Riding Hood gives Grandmother the basket of cake and bread; Grandmother thanks the huntsman for saving them, and he leaves.

s.t: "I will never leave the path," she said.
s.fr: « Je ne quitterai jamais le chemin, » dit-elle.

s.t: "That is a good lesson," said Grandmother.
s.fr: « C’est une bonne leçon, » dit Grand-mère.

s.t: Little Red Riding Hood smiled and kissed her grandmother.
s.fr: Little Red Riding Hood sourit et embrassa sa grand-mère.

s.t: From that day on, she never left the path.
s.fr: À partir de ce jour, elle ne quitta jamais le chemin.

paras.summary: Little Red Riding Hood promises to never leave the path, Grandmother calls it a good lesson, and from that day on, Little Red Riding Hood never leaves the path again.
